description: This file defines the interface and class structure for a RustAdapter plugin within the WPEFramework. It includes class definitions, configuration parameters, and method declarations for plugin lifecycle management, invocation, and communication with external components.

classes.name: RustAdapter
classes.description: A plugin class implementing the Rust::IPlugin interface, managing plugin lifecycle, configuration, and communication within the WPEFramework.

classes.name: RustAdapter::Config
classes.description: Configuration container class for the RustAdapter plugin, holding parameters such as out-of-process flag, address, port, auto-execute flag, and library name.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell interface.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for the plugin.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count for the plugin.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the plugin with the given shell.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a communication channel to the plugin.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detaches a communication channel from the plugin.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes a specific channel identified by channelId.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates a token, method, and parameters.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a method with given parameters and returns a response.

methods.name: GetLibraryPathOrName
methods.description: Retrieves the library path or name based on provided parameters.

methods.name: GetAuthToken
methods.description: Retrieves an authentication token for a given service and callsign.
